<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">Why spend your kite trip organizing your kite trip?</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">Accommodation, three meals a day,</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">bottled drinking water, kite equipment,</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">lessons/coaching and the essential kite-camp services</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">are already bundled.</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">Arrive. Put your bags down.</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">Check the wind. Go kiting.</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">ONE BOOKING. ONE PACKAGE. A LOT MORE TIME ON THE WATER.</p></div></div><a href="https://www.kitebuenhombre.com/contact" target="_self" class="a_1__O KSh0Yl comp-mt7aw7j5 style-mt9znos61__root wixui-button mfEw8N" data-testid="buttonContent" id="comp-mt7aw7j5" data-semantic-classname="button" dir="inherit" aria-label="Check the packages →"><span class="nb2UT3 GxMh7V wixui-button__label" data-testid="stylablebutton-label">Check the packages →</span><span class="KoOUdA mdITnz wixui-button__icon" aria-hidden="true" data-testid="stylablebutton-icon"><span>

<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">The 10-Day Special already delivers that:</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">11h beginner course + 5h second-level classes + 5h supervised practice (with gear included) = 21 hours.</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">&nbsp;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">The 14-Day Special adds 6 more hours of supervised practice on top &mdash; with kite gear included for free &mdash; for 11 hours of supervised practice and 27 hours total, to turn &quot;independent&quot; into &quot;confident.&quot;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">13 nights accommodation &middot;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">3 meals daily &middot; bottled water &middot; kite equipment &middot;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">11-hour beginner course &middot; second-level kite course (5h classes + 5h supervised practice) &middot;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">6 more hours of supervised practice with free kite gear rental (11h supervised practice total) &middot; camp &amp; beach services &middot;</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">storage &middot; compressor &middot; launching/landing &middot; parking &middot; lounge chairs.</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">14-Day Special: <span style="font-weight:bold;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">$2,795</span> per person</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text">Supervised practice is normally $55/hour, including gear; with kite gear included free in every package, that&#39;s a $180 value built into the price at no extra cost.</p>
<p class="font_7 wixui-rich-text__text"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>
